test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rahul can do a piece of work in 20 days whereas Rohan can do the same work in 30 days. Both started the work together and worked for 6 days with full efficiency, and in the next 6 days with half of their efficiencies. In how many days will the remaining work be finished if both work with their full efficiencies for the remaining period?
solution:
**Given:**

Rahul can do a piece of work in 20 days

Rohan can do the same work in 30 days

Both started the work together and worked for 6 days with full efficiency

Next 6 days with half of their efficiencies

**Formula used:**

Work done by Rahul in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by Rohan in 1 day = 1/30

Total work = 1 (whole work)

**Calculation:**

Work done by Rahul and Rohan together in 1 day = 1/20 + 1/30

⇒ 1/20 + 1/30 = (3 + 2) / 60 = 5 / 60 = 1 / 12

Work done in first 6 days (full efficiency):

6 × (1/12) = 6 / 12 = 1/2

Work done in next 6 days (half efficiency):

6 × (1/2) × (1/12) = 6 × 1/24 = 1/4

Total work done in 12 days = 1/2 + 1/4 = (2 + 1) / 4 = 3 / 4

Remaining work = 1 - 3/4 = 1/4

Time taken to complete the remaining work with full efficiency:

Work rate together = 1/12

⇒ (1/4) / (1/12) = (1/4) × 12 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
